A '''grapefruit''' was a type of [[Limb/Legends|handheld]]-sized [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]]. During the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]<ref name="Clone Wars" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date note">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' junior novelization]], which include the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] used grapefruit-sized [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive charges]] to destroy a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] that had defended the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Clone Army's]] ranged weaponry.<ref name="Clone Wars" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grapefruits were mentioned in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|junior novelization]] of the film [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']], which was written by [[Tracey West]] and published in [[2008]].<ref name="Clone Wars" />
